description: This file defines data structures, classes, and functions related to QUIC packet processing in the quic namespace, including packet headers, encrypted packets, received packets, and related utilities.

classes.name: QuicPacketHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a QUIC packet, including connection IDs, packet number, version info, and other header fields.

classes.name: QuicPublicResetPacket
classes.description: Represents a public reset packet in QUIC, used for connection reset signals.

classes.name: QuicVersionNegotiationPacket
classes.description: Represents a version negotiation packet in QUIC, used during handshake to negotiate protocol versions.

classes.name: QuicIetfStatelessResetPacket
classes.description: Represents an IETF QUIC stateless reset packet, used for stateless connection resets.

classes.name: QuicData
classes.description: Base class for QUIC data buffers, providing access to raw data and size.

classes.name: QuicPacket
classes.description: Represents a QUIC packet, including header and payload data.

classes.name: QuicEncryptedPacket
classes.description: Represents an encrypted QUIC packet, with cloning and output capabilities.

classes.name: QuicReceivedPacket
classes.description: Represents a received encrypted QUIC packet, including receipt time and metadata.

classes.name: SerializedPacket
classes.description: Contains information about a serialized (encrypted) QUIC packet, including buffers and frame data.

classes.name: QuicPerPacketContext
classes.description: Abstract base for context information associated with incoming packets.

classes.name: ReceivedPacketInfo
classes.description: Holds parsed information from the unencrypted bytes of a received packet.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the packet, transferring ownership of buffers.

methods.name: AsStringPiece
methods.description: Returns the data as an absl::string_view.

methods.name: Plaintext
methods.description: Returns the plaintext payload of the packet.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts ReceivedPacketInfo to a string representation.
